faq.heading: Frequently asked questions

0.q: How do I list my car on Carsens for free?

a.0: Click "Sell Your Car" in the top-right of any page, then follow the 5-step listing flow: car info → specs → photos → price → publish. Private sellers can list for free. Your car appears live within minutes of being published.
a.1: You'll get unlimited photos, 30 days of standard listing time, and full access to direct buyer messages. Upgrade to Featured (AED 99) or Premium (AED 249) for more visibility.

1.q: What's the difference between Featured and Premium listings?

0.label: Standard (FREE)
0.text: — your listing appears in normal search results for 30 days.

1.label: Featured (AED 99)
1.text: — a yellow "Featured" badge, priority placement in results, and rotation on the homepage. Typically gets 3× more views.

2.label: Premium (AED 249)
2.text: — always ranked #1 in searches, sent in push notifications to matched buyers, and pinned to the top of category pages.

2.q: How do I know if a dealer is verified?

a.0: Verified dealers have a green ✓ checkmark next to their name. We verify their trade license, physical showroom, and a track record of at least 6 months on Carsens.

1.label: Premium partners
1.text: additionally have a gold star — these dealers meet a higher standard for response time, customer reviews, and verified RTA registration.

3.q: Can I book a test drive directly through Carsens?

a.0: Yes — on any car detail page, click "Schedule a test drive" in the dealer contact card. The dealer typically confirms within 2 hours during business hours. You'll receive an SMS reminder the day before.

4.q: How does the Carsens 200-point inspection work?

a.0: For AED 350, a Carsens-certified inspector comes to the seller's location (anywhere in the UAE) and runs a 200-point check covering engine, body, interior, electronics, brakes, and tires. You get a PDF report within 24 hours, before any commitment.
a.1: Many dealer listings already include a recent Carsens Inspection — look for the green inspection badge on the car detail page.

5.q: What payment methods are safe for car purchases in the UAE?

a.0: For dealer purchases, always pay via UAE bank transfer to the dealer's registered business account — never to a personal account. Verify the trade license number matches.
a.1: For private purchases, complete the transaction at an RTA office or bank branch — never wire money before transferring the Mulkiya. Avoid cash deals for high-value cars.

6.q: Can I get my listing removed if my car sold elsewhere?

0.post: , find the car, and click "Mark as sold" or "Remove listing." This takes effect immediately. You'll keep your listing history for your records.

7.q: How do I report a suspicious listing or buyer?

a.0: On any listing page, click the ⋮ menu and select "Report listing." For suspicious messages, open the message thread and click "Report user." Our trust & safety team reviews every report within 4 hours.
